div.head: II As 23.2
div.ab: ⁊ ofga ælc mon his tihtlan mid foreaðe, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo þæra ælc fæstende on ægþera hond se ðær mid sy, on Godes bebode ⁊ ðæs ærcebiscopes; ⁊ ne beo ðær on naþre healf na ma monna þonne XII. Gif se getihtloda mon ðonne maran werude beo þonne twelfa sum, þonne beo þæt ordal forod, buton hy him from gan willon.

And every man shall precede his accusation with an oath, as we have already declared, and everyone who is present in both parties shall fast according to the command of God and the archbishop. And there shall not be more than twelve on either side. If, however, the accused man is one of a party greater than twelve, the ordeal shall be invalidated, unless they will leave him.

⁊ ofga ylc man his tyhtan mid foreaþ, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo ðæra ylc fæstende on ægþere hand ðe ðær sy, be Godes bebode ⁊ ðæs bisceopes; ⁊ ne beo ðær on nawþre healfa ma manne ðonne XII. Gif ðonne se getyhtleda man maran weorod sy þonne XII sum, ðonne sy þæt ordale forode, buton hi him fram gán wille.
